title: A Verdict for the Witness
author: Quentin Dunmore
blurb: Elodie Crane, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
